preparationHook:
-- Temporary fixed Studio acceptance preparation; excluded from repository sources/build.
local qa=Instance.new('BindableFunction');qa.Name='BrickToadsPigQA';qa.Parent=game.ServerStorage
local qaData={events={},phases={}};local seenSession,lastPhase,lastSample=nil,'',0
local stopOn
local function current()
 local c=controller.groups['group-1'].controller
 return c,c.world,c.current,c.director
end
local function pose(w,id,x,z,forward)
 local a=assert(w.actors[id]);local p=Vector3.new(x,3,z)+w.offset
 a.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(p,p+Vector3.new(forward or 1,0,0)))
 a.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;a.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
end
local function pause(w,d)
 for id,e in d.enemies do if not e.dead then
  e.nextAttack=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+3600;e.windup=nil;e.rushing=nil
  local a=w.actors[id];if a then a.root.Anchored=true;w:move(id,0,0) end
 end end
end
local function inspect()
 local c,w,s,d=current();if not s then return {ready=false} end
 local actors={}
 for id,a in w.actors do if id>-1000 then
  actors[tostring(id)]={position=w:position(id),identity=a.model:GetAttribute('ActorId'),health=a.model:GetAttribute('HealthRaw'),
   action=a.model:GetAttribute('PrimaryAttack'),phase=a.model:GetAttribute('AttackPhase'),anchored=a.root.Anchored}
 end end
 return {snapshot=c:snapshot(game.Players:GetPlayers()[1],game.Players:GetPlayers()),actors=actors,events=qaData.events,phases=qaData.phases}
end
local function initial()
 local c,w,s,d=current();pause(w,d)
 pose(w,1,-64.5,0,1);pose(w,-2,-60,0,-1);pose(w,-1,-30,20,-1);pose(w,-3,-10,-20,-1)
end
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
 local c,w,s,d=current();if not s then return end
 if s~=seenSession then
  seenSession=s;local old=s.logger
  s.logger=function(row)
   if old then old(row) end
   if row.kind=='Hit' then
    table.insert(qaData.events,row)
    if stopOn and stopOn[row.data.action] then pause(w,d);stopOn=nil end
   end
  end
  initial()
 end
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 if now-lastSample>.04 then
  lastSample=now;local phases={}
  for id,e in d.enemies do if e.kind=='Pig' and not e.dead then
   local a=w.actors[id];phases[tostring(id)]={action=a.model:GetAttribute('PrimaryAttack'),phase=a.model:GetAttribute('AttackPhase'),
    pending=e.windup and e.windup.action,rushing=e.rushing==true}
  end end
  local encoded=HttpService:JSONEncode(phases)
  if encoded~=lastPhase then
   lastPhase=encoded;table.insert(qaData.phases,{at=now,heroes=s:snapshot().heroes,actors=phases})
  end
 end
end)
qa.OnInvoke=function(action)
 local c,w,s,d=current();assert(s,'Start the game first')
 if action=='initial' then initial()
 elseif action=='humanReady' then w.actors[-2].root.Anchored=false;d.enemies[-2].nextAttack=workspace:GetServerTimeNow();stopOn={PigJab=true}
 elseif action=='prepareFly' then
  pause(w,d)
  local ids={};for id,e in d.enemies do if not e.dead then table.insert(ids,id) end end
  for _,id in ids do d:_kill(id,'QAPreparation') end
  d:_enterZone(3);pause(w,d)
  pose(w,1,174.5,-5,1);pose(w,-7,160,20,1);pose(w,-8,210,20,-1)
  assert(s:_hit(-7,1,'PigRush'))
  task.delay(.9,function()pose(w,1,174.5,-5,1)end)
 elseif action=='chain' then
  assert(s.combat[1].rawLife==39,'Catch the actual healing fly first')
  pause(w,d);pose(w,1,178,0,1);pose(w,-7,182.5,0,-1);pose(w,-8,172.5,0,1)
  local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow();d.enemies[-7].nextAttack=now+.2;d.enemies[-8].nextAttack=now+.6
  stopOn={PigHeavy=true}
 elseif action=='rush' then
  pause(w,d);pose(w,1,191,0,-1);pose(w,-7,174,0,1);pose(w,-8,220,20,-1)
  w.actors[-7].root.Anchored=false;d.enemies[-7].nextAttack=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+.3
  d.random=function()return 1 end
  stopOn={PigRush=true}
 elseif action=='inspect' then return inspect()
 else error('Unknown fixed QA action') end
 return inspect()
end
